purpose: Numerical accelerator generated exclusively from the live updated molecular forward kernel; not an independent physical model.

interpolation.uncertainty_bounds: tensor-product cubic interpolation of logarithmic positive distance from central Delta-prime-17O
interpolation.coordinates: pO2, pCO2, and natural log of absolute GPP
interpolation.central_delta18: local tensor-product quadratic in pO2, ln(pCO2), and ln(GPP)

construction.numerical_specification: updated-forward-v1; fixed-point tolerance=1e-8 per mil; maximum Newton iterations=36; finite-difference steps=[0.001,0.0001] per mil
construction.lower_GPP_boundary_reason: 5% of Young modern GPP is the lowest rectangular-domain value verified at all pO2/pCO2 corners; lower GPP can violate positive gross-O2 steady-state closure at high pCO2.

biology_envelope_refresh.method: exact live-kernel solves at every training node
biology_envelope_refresh.unchanged_fields: central isotope state and Adnew source-isoflux interval

construction.refinement: insert every geometric midpoint on pCO2 and absolute-GPP axes; retain the original pO2 nodes; exact live-kernel values at every new node
construction.pO2_refinement: insert every geometric midpoint on the pO2 axis; retain the refined pCO2 and absolute-GPP axes; exact live-kernel values at every new node

previous_294_to_60000ppm_validation.holdout_design: Noncentral logarithmic fractions in the two lowest-GPP intervals for every pO2-pCO2 cell, plus a deterministic evenly indexed sample across all remaining GPP intervals.

construction.specification: geometric midpoints in every pO2 and pCO2 interval and in the four lowest-GPP intervals; exact central molecular-kernel values

delta18_surface.interpolation: local tensor-product quadratic in pO2, natural-log pCO2, and natural-log absolute GPP
